* System 1 from UIR2. Flow 1=exp, 2=hypoexp, 3=uniform, 4=trace.
* For UIR2 use Flow=1, Gap=1 and MeanS=2.
* For trace use Gap=169.573210 and MeanS=load*Gap/0.6.
Flow      EQU 1
Gap       EQU 1
MeanS     EQU 2
Mode      EQU 1
BufferTwo STORAGE 4
WaitSmo   TABLE MP1,1,1,500
SojSmo    TABLE M1,1,1,500
IntExp    VARIABLE (Exponential(2,0,Gap))
IntHypo   VARIABLE (Exponential(2,0,Gap#107.337420/169.573210)+Exponential(2,0,Gap#31.117895/169.573210)+Exponential(2,0,Gap#31.117895/169.573210))
IntUnif   VARIABLE (Uniform(2,0,2#Gap))
TraceSeq  FUNCTION P2,D300

* One source transaction creates arrivals by SPLIT.
          GENERATE 0,0,0,1
          ASSIGN 2,1
NextGap   TEST E Flow,4,NotTrace
          ADVANCE FN$TraceSeq
          ASSIGN 2+,1
          TEST LE P2,300,Wrap
          TRANSFER ,SendJob
Wrap      ASSIGN 2,1
          TRANSFER ,SendJob
NotTrace  TEST E Flow,1,TryHypo
          ADVANCE V$IntExp
          TRANSFER ,SendJob
TryHypo   TEST E Flow,2,UseUniform
          ADVANCE V$IntHypo
          TRANSFER ,SendJob
UseUniform ADVANCE V$IntUnif
SendJob   SPLIT 1,Arrival
          TRANSFER ,NextGap
Arrival   MARK
          MARK 1
          TRANSFER .4,,LaneTwo
          GATE NU ServerOne,DropJob
          SEIZE ServerOne
          ASSIGN 4,1
          TRANSFER ,BeginSvc
LaneTwo   GATE SNF BufferTwo,DropJob
          ENTER BufferTwo
          QUEUE LineTwo
          SEIZE ServerTwo
          DEPART LineTwo
          ASSIGN 4,2
BeginSvc  TABULATE WaitSmo
          TEST E Mode,1,TryErl
          ADVANCE (Exponential(3,0,MeanS))
          TRANSFER ,FinishSvc
TryErl    TEST E Mode,2,TryHyp
          ADVANCE (Exponential(3,0,MeanS/2)+Exponential(3,0,MeanS/2))
          TRANSFER ,FinishSvc
TryHyp    TRANSFER 0.112701665,Fast,Slow
Fast      ADVANCE (Exponential(3,0,MeanS/1.774596669))
          TRANSFER ,FinishSvc
Slow      ADVANCE (Exponential(3,0,MeanS/0.225403331))
FinishSvc TABULATE SojSmo
          TEST E P4,1,FreeTwo
          RELEASE ServerOne
          TERMINATE 1
FreeTwo   RELEASE ServerTwo
          LEAVE BufferTwo
          TERMINATE 1
DropJob   SAVEVALUE Lost+,1
          TERMINATE 1
          RMULT 4201,4202,4203
          START 20000,NP
          RESET
          INITIAL X$Lost,0
          START 200000
